fusions.name: Peened Rivet
fusions.desc: A flattening blow that deals 16 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Drive Every Stake
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3 tiles takes 9 damage. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Hammered Home
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 5 health.

fusions.name: Settled Seam
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your physical damage rises 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
